2562117.name: Chabad at Northeastern University
2562117.note: COLlive, 25 Apr 2014 ('New Shluchim to Boston'): 'Rabbi Mendy and Mussy Posner have been appointed as the new Shluchim to the Fenway-Huntington Ave. area of Boston'; 'Their work will focus primarily on the Jewish students at the prominent Northeastern University'. Its chabad.org listing went up 25 July 2014.
